summary.text: Lorwyn follows the elf Rhys, who is demoted and branded an outlaw after a raid on boggarts goes wrong when he invokes Colfenor's magic and a poison blast kills nearly everyone, and he later kills the Gilt-Leaf commander Nath at Kinsbaile.
Alongside him, the flamekin Ashling begins a pilgrimage in search of the greater elemental of her birth, gaining companions such as Brigid Baeli.
Behind it all, the faerie queen Oona schemes to stay in power as the Great Aurora approaches, and it transforms Lorwyn into Shadowmoor.
